items.title: A covering of a quasi-compact object contains a finite subfamily presenting the object by extension by zero
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a covering {U_i -> U} with U quasi-compact, some finite subfamily I' already gives an exact sequence presenting j_!O_U by the extensions by zero along the members of the subfamily and their pairwise fibre products. The proof first reduces to the case where U satisfies a stronger quasi-compactness condition, then in general uses the definition of quasi-compactness to find a refinement V of the covering U whose index image I' is finite, and checks exactness of the resulting sequence by applying Hom into an arbitrary module and using the standard sequence coming from the lower shriek construction (proof lines 5306-5334). H2: the reduction to a finite-index refinement and the Hom-test for exactness are the substance; the author explicitly says the reader may skip the general case, which is nonetheless written out.
